Hi Jia / Sentral Ops team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great to see the preliminary numbers. As discussed, Sentral wants to run a 24-hour POC specifically to validate cold-start tail latency under sustained spike conditions (pattern: 10k small requests/hour with intermittent 1k concurrent bursts). That run needs a short-term credits top-up so your engineering team can execute without hitting trial caps.

Quick summary of ask:
- Temporary promo credits for a 24-hour window (estimated 1.8M tokens total; buffer request: 2.5M)
- Start window: Mon 18 Jun 2028, 02:00 UTC (flexible by a few hours)
- Primary validation: p95/p99 cold-start latency across real traffic replay; goal p99 < 450ms for endpoint variant A

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the start window and target token estimate.
2) We provide a brief mutual action plan (Vivek will share the test script and metrics dashboard link).
3) Internal sign-off: Marissa will approve a short-term promotional credit, Finance/CS will confirm billing guardrails.

If you can confirm by end of day, we can give operational greenlight and ship the credits. Attachment: Sentral_PoC_matrix.xlsx (overview of traffic profile).

Best,
Camila
